reviews.title: IT IS A BIG AND WONDERFUL CASE
reviews.comment: This is a great full ATX case.  Plenty of room for the installation of my RTX 4080 Super on a ASUS TUF Games Z890 Mother board.  The power supply unit installs at the bottom in separate air flow than the main box.  Cable management is made easy as you can run everything behind the mother board.  The glass is tempered and looks great.  It comes with 4 RGB fans that interface though an included RGB hub.  The directions that come with this case are not good and provides no guidance on how the RGB hub should be hooked into the mother board.  If you get this case use a SATA power cable from your PSU to power the RGB fan hub and connect the ARGB cable from the hub to one of the three prong ARGB connectors on the mother board.  You can manually change the colors using the LED button on the front control panel or if you push and hold that LED button for 7 or 8 seconds the mother board can control the case fans colors.  Also know, there is no fan speed control for the fans that come with the case, the hub does not have that interface. The fans do keep air flowing very effectively.  I installed a TRYX Panorama SE 360 ARGB 360mm AIO and running a full bench test my CPU and GPU temps have never exceeded 65C.  Normal temps average around 37 to 50 C while gaming.  The fans that come installed in the case are very quiet.
reviews.author: Shel J.

reviews.title: In love with this case!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1kCfI4ScVL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/41gBEpepxLL._SY256.jpg I decided to go with this case for my ultimate build, and I don't regret it a bit.
The case looks even better in person, it is big though, and a bit heavy, perfect for me as I like my computers big and imposing.
The fans are nice, syncs well with the rgb in my cooler and rams, the light modes are varied and cool, there's multiple choices to make your pc lighting look great.
A small problem would be the cable management at the back of the case, the cables come a bit tangled up and you must rearrange everything to make it snug and clean. Besides that I didn't have any other problem and the installation was swift.
Totally recommended for its price as the quality is incredible.
reviews.author: Nicolas Corral

reviews.title: Lots of space, great show case and exactly what I wanted in a set up!
reviews.comment:
BIG NOTE!!! For this case when purchased in black! The glass is tinted, the images almost make you think they are clear but it's definitely tinted you can see in the photos. Luckily for me with how easy it is to remove the panels I run it with no glass when I play it. Second note the 3 fans not on the rear of the tower are reverse finned to allow air flow in with the aesthetic of not looking that the fan supports for the motor. Last note when tucking the wires on the black side and you have a larger wad of wires, if sticking out just too far it will push against the panel and it'll not hold on.. learned the hard way.
Overall its what I wanted from a case, I wanted to put my 360mm radiator on the side like I have it in this one. Love the glass and how easy it is. The removable corner piece perfect. I like the sneak a fan or hard drive under the bottom little drop shelf there and the hide away everything for your wires. It's also set up for the graphics card to be side mounted I'm definitely considering. The adjustment possibilities for all the fans are great because the holes are slotted it's amazing. Now you can set them to where it feels right rather than it being set although those slots end up making it feel flimsy that's just the other end of the coin when it comes to that. Great for supporting your radiators because most of the time when you have a corner of the case and your hoses coming off the radiator end up hitting the fan and makes you end up needing to try something different. So definitely satisfied, if I get another definitely white but I do love my grey and black theme!
reviews.author: Elizabeth Willor

reviews.title: I was initially disappointed, but this ended up being one of my smoothest builds...
reviews.comment:
I've built roughly 20 PCs in the past two months.  I personally run a Corsair 5000D, so I've done more Corsair cases than any other brand, but have been trying a few others out, as Corsair and NZXT want an arm and a leg for their AIO and Fans.  The other atrocity with Corsair is them shipping their white cases with basic black fans unless you pay more for the RGB option and then it is their basic RGB fans...
I've bought a grip of SAMA PSUs recently, as they have been very reasonably priced for their rated powers and 80+ Gold and Platinum offerings.  I saw this case and found that SAMA's AIO was reasonably priced and you could order reverse blades fans at a reasonable price.  The case comes with 3 reverse blade fans on the rear to the right of the MOBO and a regular rear exhaust fan.  The disappointment came when I opened the back panel to find a 4 fan and ARGB hub that was full before extra fans and AIO.  Then I recognized that the ARGB cables all had the ability to daisy chain more, though the pre-installed fans did not, this was a relief.  The front panel controls are actually on the base of the tempered glass panel and tucked into the bottom of the case, which was really easy to work with.  I thought I would be able to add 3 fans to the bottom, but it looks like I was mistaken.  There are only two holes to mount a fan, either 120 or 140 on the lower level at the front, whereas the space elevated below the motherboard has a few screw holes, but I don't think one could mount fans with 1 screw and expect them to be stable.  Either way they only had one reverse fan blade fans in white in stock last week, but I had already ordered 2 more today before I started this build.  The top cover is mounted with pressure mounts, but they provide two silver thumb screws to secure it, which is nice.  They also provide two replacement female pressure mounts in the event one fails over time.  Reasonable cable management options and clean finish.  This build was SAMA case, PSU, AIO and additional fans.  One of the easiest builds, very little tight/cramped spaces and I can't wait til I plug it in and setup the OS and see how it looks lit up.
